content_sections.heading: Official Source
content_sections.text: This article is based on the official notification of Office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Sitamarhi, dated 17 November 2026. Candidates should verify every detail in that notification before applying.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Principal District and Sessions Judge, Sitamarhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Principal District and Sessions Judge, Sitamarhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Stenographer, 1 Clerk, 1 Peon/Orderly.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Principal District and Sessions Judge, Sitamarhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form and send it to Office of the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Sitamarhi, by in person or registered post, to reach by 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Remuneration governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority; no amount printed.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Retired employees of the Civil Courts who retired within the preceding three years as per Patna High Court guidelines. Stenographer: experience and proficiency in shorthand and typing. Clerk: knowledge and experience of clerical and judicial office work. Peon/Orderly: capable of performing the duties of the post. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a retired employee of the Civil Courts. Must have retired within the preceding three years as per guidelines issued by the High Court, Patna. Must be physically and mentally fit to discharge the duties of the respective post. Must possess satisfactory service records.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Retired employees subjected to any major disciplinary punishment during service.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Engagement is purely contractual in nature for the Evening Court. Period of engagement, remuneration and other conditions governed by applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority. Engagement confers no right to claim regular appointment or continuation in service.
